mer_cook.text: Cawl: lamb, leeks, swede, potatoes, carrots and patience. Better the next day, they say, but nobody ever lets it last till the next day.
In the old days you ate it with bread and cheese on the side, and a spoon you'd had since your wedding.

mer_shopper.text: I come for the cheese and leave with a pair of wellies, a lamp and three secondhand books. They all work out, somehow.
Glamorgan sausage is a vegetarian sausage, you know. Cheese, leeks and breadcrumbs. They used to make it with real sausage; Glamorgan said no thank you.
